issue.title: Image modal resize intermittently times out waiting for the second render
issue.description: Proposed by sase-1nn.8.4.3.2 note 1. Independently inspected Python 3.12 logs at identical SHA 7b1b43755821fb4b6fe9ab8f51d09fcff0e46879: Full CI 40109539212 job 120943525406 fails _second_render_landed after 5 seconds; Full CI 40108758095 job 120918910038 completes with 23 unrelated failures and this node passes. One failure in two observed same-SHA runs. No serial reproduction performed. Root cause unestablished; inspect resize/render worker publication and semantic readiness without raising timeout, skipping, or retrying assertions.
